notes: Chelsea is about 15 miles west of Ann Arbor. The library page says teen volunteers need a work permit even though the role is unpaid.
name: Teen Service Group (library volunteers)
what_you_do: Help the youth and teen librarians plan and run programs, sign kids up for the Reading Program, and do other tasks all year.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The group runs year-round.
how_to_apply: Send in the online application or the 2026 printable PDF. Teens must also complete a work permit. The page says that from October 2, permits are done online in the Youth Employment Permit Portal (YEPP). Call Stacey at 734-475-8732 ext. 212.
